tasks.prompt: We have prompt A and prompt B for a support bot, 240 redacted historical tickets tagged by intent and language, and a policy handbook. Design a release eval.
criteria: defines a decision-linked primary metric, guardrails, and ship threshold
uses paired runs on the same held-out cases and reports intent/language segments
combines deterministic policy checks with a calibrated rubric and human adjudication
preserves raw outputs and configuration identity without inventing results

tasks.prompt: Design an evaluation for a RAG assistant that must answer from internal manuals and cite sources, but should abstain when the manuals do not contain the answer.
criteria: separates retrieval quality from answer-generation quality
measures claim support, citation correctness/coverage, and abstention
includes answerable, unanswerable, conflicting, and retrieval-failure cases
specifies corpus/index versioning and evidence retained per case

tasks.prompt: Our travel agent can search flights, hold a seat, and charge a test card. Build an offline regression eval for a new model.
criteria: uses a sandbox or fake tools and forbids production side effects
scores tool choice, arguments, sequence, authorization gates, and final state
covers tool errors, retries, duplicate-charge prevention, and stopping behavior
separates task quality from latency, cost, and infrastructure errors
